command:
set -eu
boot_id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
marker="log-retention-pre-reboot-$boot_id"
logger -t log-retention-evidence -- "$marker"
journalctl --sync
printf 'boot_id=%s\n' "$boot_id"
printf 'journald_active='; systemctl is-active systemd-journald
printf 'rsyslog_active='; systemctl is-active rsyslog
printf '%s\n' 'effective_journald_settings:'
systemd-analyze cat-config systemd/journald.conf | sed -n '/retention.conf/,$p'
printf '%s\n' 'persistent_storage:'
find /var/log/journal -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p %s bytes\n' | sort
printf '%s\n' 'persistent_marker:'
journalctl --directory=/var/log/journal -t log-retention-evidence --no-pager -o short-iso | tail -n 3
printf 'journal_disk='; journalctl --disk-usage
printf '%s\n' 'journal_integrity:'
journalctl --verify --quiet && printf '%s\n' verified
